chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"Travel is a portion of torment, so when one of you has completed his journey, let him hasten to return to his family."

key_terms.الْعَذَابِ: hardship, suffering, or torment in context

ai.seo_question: What does the Imam عليه السلام teach about returning home after travel?
ai.summary: The hadith teaches that travel involves hardship and discomfort for a person. It therefore encourages one who has finished the purpose of the journey not to delay, but to return promptly to their family.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Travel is a portion of torment, so when one of you has completed their journey, let them hasten to return to their family."
